title: My favorite app - changed my life
body:

The design is thoughtful. The app allows flexibility in terms of category, naming, and metrics so that you can customize things for the precise habit or goal you’re working towards. Even with all the flexibility the app is still functional and doesn’t have superfluous features that make it clunky like some other apps I’ve seen in this category.

title: Very useful
body:
This is so good, one of the few apps I think I will pay for. 

I’ve really gotten out of routine during the Covid lockdown, so thought I would use this to get back on track. 

It really is good, you can use it to build up good habits, reduce or limit bad habits or things bad for you. For example drink water 4 times a day.  Don’t eat more than 4 packets of crisps a week! Go to bed before 11am every night. Lol 

The goals can be set daily, weekly, monthly or averaged out. 

It’s not advertised for this purpose, but it could also be used as a reminder to take medication (as multiple reminders through the day can be set for the same item).

Or even as a task or to do list, with daily, weekly, monthly reminders set.  In fact get this and it could replace several of your other apps entirely!

 Plus it has a note section which could actually be used as a well being diary for each item you set.  Ie bad habits, you could explain to yourself why you had more than 4 packets of crisps that week! Plus you can set your own messages. So when it reminds you to drink water - you can add, because my doctor told me! 

It would be better though if different types of tagged items were displayed in different colours, with the option of grouping them together.  I see the list can be reordered but a group function would be better.  

It could also do with some clearer instructions as it took me a few goes to set up a tag title and work out how to re-order the items.

title: Too many subjects not enough time?
body:
This app is so useful for getting organised. It may seem like an overstatement to say it's changed my life but it really has. Between my work and let's be honest relaxing time I never found enough hours to complete all my studies this app really is great for building habits and it's so easy to stick to them.

A good tip for anyone using this is build a habit at a time in which you know you'll always be free to do it and nothing will impede it. For me unfortunately that's the middle of the night 1am, 2am etc. Hopefully yours aren't as late, in any case if you build a habit at a time when you'll always be free to do it you'll be amazed at how easy it is to stick to it and how much you get done. 1 hour a day of a subject over a period of time is much more rewarding than one day of cramming a subject. Excellent for getting rid of bad habits as well. 

Only issue is sometimes when editing a habit it takes a while to update properly.

title: So disappointed that I've abandoned my goals :(

Don't get me wrong I expect to pay for quality Apps but I don't think subscription models like this offer good value for money and $50 is far too high anyway. I've been so upset and disillusioned I'm now not bothering with my goals any more.

author: Ray8373

title: Still buggy! It's a shame really.
body:
I bought the app before it was updated. It was buggy and kept crashing all the time. This has not changed, in fact it's worse; a lot worse. 

I'm running the app on an iPhone 6. 

Problems: (yes, I've tried deleting and restarting my phone many times) 

Still crashes when adding a tracker, or just randomly crashes. Random crashes happen a lot, even so that I've stopped using the app. The is basically unusable. 

Sometimes when adding a new tracker, it syncs to server and keeps adding multiple versions of the same tracker to the dashboard. 

I bought the app before the update and I'm being told that I will have to pay for a subscription, which with the apps performance I really wouldn't recommend or intend to do. To be honest, to buy the app, then pay for subscription, and provide terrible service and user experience is insulting. 

App animations/transitions are jarring. Not smooth at all. 

Really slow boot up time

I personally find the app quite ugly, this is exacerbated by the poor animations. 

I wanted to love this app as it's possible to track many data types. No other app does this and that's what makes this app so frustrating. If you can forgive it for its bugginess and poor looks, then it's ok. I believe the app looks the way it does as it has to allow for disparate data types, most other apps in this area have very nice looking dashboards for example. 

The idea behind the app is excellent, a one stop place to track various things you want change. Sadly the execution is rather poor. Hopefully, I'll be able to change my review once the app has been updated again.

title: Not worth paying for
body: This app is not worth the money - and that's saying something considering it only costs £2.49. Basic to look at. Complicated to use with limited options and strange updating system. You can't just tick off that you've completed your task for the day, if you want to drink three glasses of water a day, you can't just confirm that you've done it, you must check off three times for it to count, it just seems a little convoluted. It would work better if you could type in the amount you've drank or just hit enter to confirm you met the goal. Think it tries to offer something that a lot of apps out there can do better.

author: belfastbiker

title: Clean, Lean & Useful!
body: I really don't understand some people, like reviewer number one who says "the app does not give you any instructions". There's a website link in the settings that takes you to a mobile help site which very clearly details how to use the app. It is also not difficult to figure out after a few clicks. Fairness is a great virtue. The app is fine. Actually one of the simpler of "quantified self" apps. But the simplicity is in its user interface, not what it does. Instead of page after page of statistical data and pie charts, the app does all the calculations in the background, so you just see how you are doing, in a simple and intuitive way. I think this is the app's greatest strength! If the developer kindly makes it universal binary, or at least develops an iPad version too, then I will give it another 5 star!
